'''Brink Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] outside the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]]. The [[Red Ronto]] was situated aboard the station.<ref name="Crucible" />
